payload.claim: The spec requires updating saffron/follow_up.py's module and function docstrings to name `cite` (criterion 1), but places no equivalent requirement on saffron/finish.py's `publish_finish` docstring (criterion 3), whose first paragraph stays textually silent about the new gate-name suffix on the escalation line even though the code's behavior changes. This costs nothing to leave for the operator since the escalation line itself is correctly specified.
